english.title: Knowingly / recklessly give false information to the Office of Fair Trading
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), for the purposes of, or in connection with, a requirement imposed or provision made by or under the Consumer Credit Act 1974, namely **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT OR PROVISION..), knowingly or recklessly gave information to

(A)_[the Office of Fair Trading]_
(B)_[an officer of the Office of Fair Trading, namely **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..)]_

which was false or misleading in a material particular
english.legislation: Contrary to section 7 of, and Schedule 1 to, the Consumer Credit Act 1974.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a Fine.

Time Limit on Prosecutions;
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
